name: Forecast chart prompt
description: A prompt panel that turns a typed question or a dropped CSV into an animated forecast chart with a confidence band, count-up figures and a keyboard read-out.

default: Forecast column D revenue next quarter

default.cols: A Category, B Planned, C Actual · 7 rows
default.prompt: Compare planned and actual spend and flag any overspend

propDocs.productForm: First part of the two-tone product name shown in the horizon picker.
propDocs.productSuffix: Second part of the product name, drawn in the section tint.
propDocs.prompts: Array of strings typed into the empty prompt one after another.
propDocs.horizons: Array of {n, label, note}; n is the number of forecast steps. The second entry is the default.
propDocs.templates: Array of {id, name, feat, cols, fm, prompt} in chip order. The id selects the built-in sample sheet (budget, pipeline, invoices, habits, inventory, grades, timeline, revenue, pivot, currency, loan, workout, guests).
propDocs.labels: Object with every interface string; keys left out keep their English default.

fallback: The poster shows the idle prompt panel. With reduced motion the prompt shows its first suggestion, no typing loop runs, and results appear at once in their settled state.
